chunks: 2725 - And ʿAbdullāh ibn Muskan narrated from Abū Baṣīr, who said:

I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a muhrim who struck an ostrich or a wild donkey. He said, “A camel is due upon him.” I said, “If he is not able?” He said, “He feeds sixty needy persons.” I said, “If he is not able to give in charity, what is upon him?” He said, “Then let him fast eighteen days.” I said, “If he struck a cow, what is upon him?” He said, “A cow is due upon him.” I said, “If he is not able?” He said, “Then let him feed thirty needy persons.” I said, “If he is not able to give in charity?” He said, “Then let him fast nine days.” I said, “If he struck a gazelle, what is upon him?” He said, “A sheep is due upon him.” I said, “If he does not find it?” He said, “Then feeding ten needy persons is upon him.” I said, “If he does not find what he can give in charity?” He said, “Then fasting three days is upon him.”

key_terms.بَدَنَةٌ: a camel offered as sacrificial compensation
key_terms.حِمَارَ وَحْشٍ: a wild donkey subject to the same expiation ruling here
key_terms.صِيَامُ: fasting as the substitute expiation when other options are not possible
key_terms.ظَبْياً: a gazelle hunted while in ihram
key_terms.مُحْرِمٍ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.مِسْكِيناً: a needy person to be fed as expiation
key_terms.نَعَامَةً: an ostrich hunted while in ihram

ai.seo_question: What expiation must a muhrim give for killing an ostrich, wild donkey, cow, or gazelle during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith sets out the expiatory rulings for a muhrim who kills certain game animals during ihram. It establishes a graded legal structure: sacrificial compensation if possible, feeding needy persons if not, and fasting if even that is beyond one's means.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2725 - Abdullah ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a person in the state of ihram who hunted an ostrich or a wild donkey.
Imam (as) said: "They must offer a camel."
I asked: "What if they cannot afford it?"
Imam (as) said: "They should feed sixty needy people."
I asked: "What if they cannot afford to feed anyone?"
Imam (as) said: "They must fast for eighteen days."
I then asked: "What if they hunted a cow?"
Imam (as) said: "They must offer a cow."
I asked: "What if they cannot afford it?"
Imam (as) said: "They should feed thirty needy people."
I asked: "What if they cannot afford to feed anyone?"
Imam (as) said: "They must fast for nine days."
I then asked: "What if they hunted a gazelle?"
Imam (as) said: "They must offer a sheep."
I asked: "What if they cannot afford it?"
Imam (as) said: "They must feed ten needy people."
I asked: "What if they cannot afford to feed anyone?"
Imam (as) said: "They must fast for three days."
